<html lang="fr"><head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Tracking Data — Media Intelligence</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@300;400;600;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --navy: #0B1628;
    --navy-mid: #132035;
    --navy-light: #1C2F4A;
    --orange: #E86B2A;
    --orange-light: #F28C4E;
    --orange-glow: rgba(232,107,42,0.15);
    --white: #F4F1EC;
    --white-dim: rgba(244,241,236,0.6);
    --white-faint: rgba(244,241,236,0.08);
    --border: rgba(244,241,236,0.1);
    --mono: 'DM Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
  }

  body.light-mode {
    --navy: #F4F1EC;
    --navy-mid: #E8E4DC;
    --navy-light: #DDD8CE;
    --white: #0B1628;
    --white-dim: rgba(11,22,40,0.6);
    --white-faint: rgba(11,22,40,0.06);
    --border: rgba(11,22,40,0.12);
  }

  body.light-mode .nav-cta { color: white !important; }
  body.light-mode .mockup-source-name { color: var(--white); }

  /* Mobile menu */
  .mobile-menu-btn {
    display: none;
    background: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--white);
    padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
  }

  .mobile-menu {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 60px;
    left: 0; right: 0;
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    z-index: 99;
    padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
  }

  .mobile-menu.open { display: flex; }

  .mobile-menu a {
    color: var(--white-dim);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0.9rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    transition: color 0.3s;
  }

  .mobile-menu a:hover { color: var(--orange); }
  .mobile-menu a:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

  .theme-btn {
    background: var(--white-faint);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--white-dim);
    padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }

  .theme-btn:hover { border-color: var(--orange); color: var(--orange); }

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    background: var(--navy);
    color: var(--white);
    font-family: 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 300;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* ─── NAV ─── */
  nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 1.2rem 4rem;
    background: rgba(11,22,40,0.85);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .nav-logo {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .nav-logo-icon {
    width: 36px; height: 36px;
    background: var(--orange);
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .nav-logo-icon::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 20px; height: 20px;
    border: 2.5px solid white;
    border-radius: 50%;
  }

  .nav-logo-icon::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px; height: 8px;
    background: white;
    border-radius: 50%;
    top: 7px; right: 7px;
  }

  .nav-logo-text {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 1rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--white);
  }

  .nav-logo-text span { color: var(--orange); }

  .nav-links {
    display: flex; gap: 2.5rem; list-style: none;
  }

  .nav-links a {
    color: var(--white-dim);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: color 0.3s;
  }

  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--orange); }

  .nav-cta {
    background: var(--orange);
    color: white !important;
    padding: 0.55rem 1.4rem;
    border-radius: 2px;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    transition: background 0.3s !important;
  }

  .nav-cta:hover { background: var(--orange-light) !important; color: white !important; }

  .nav-cta-outline {
    background: transparent !important;
    color: var(--orange) !important;
    padding: 0.45rem 1.1rem;
    border-radius: 2px;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    border: 1px solid var(--orange) !important;
    transition: all 0.3s !important;
  }

  .nav-cta-outline:hover {
    background: var(--orange-glow) !important;
    color: var(--orange) !important;
  }

  body.light-mode .nav-cta-outline { color: var(--orange) !important; }

  /* ─── HERO ─── */
  #hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 8rem 4rem 4rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    gap: 4rem;
  }

  .hero-bg {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 60% at 70% 50%, rgba(232,107,42,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 40% at 10% 80%, rgba(19,32,53,0.8) 0%, transparent 60%);
  }

  .hero-grid {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(var(--border) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 60px 60px;
    mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 80% at 70% 50%, black 30%, transparent 100%);
  }

  .hero-left { position: relative; z-index: 2; }

  .hero-tag {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--orange);
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--orange-glow);
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: var(--orange-glow);
  }

  .hero-tag::before {
    content: '';
    width: 6px; height: 6px;
    background: var(--orange);
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: pulse 2s infinite;
  }

  @keyframes  pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.8); }
  }

  .hero-title {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-size: clamp(3rem, 5vw, 5rem);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.08;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }

  .hero-title em {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--orange);
  }

  .hero-sub {
    color: var(--white-dim);
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
    max-width: 480px;
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  }

  .hero-actions {
    display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .btn-primary {
    background: var(--orange);
    color: white;
    padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
    border: none; border-radius: 2px;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }

  .btn-primary:hover {
    background: var(--orange-light);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(232,107,42,0.3);
  }

  .btn-secondary {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--white);
    padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 2px;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }

  .btn-secondary:hover {
    border-color: var(--orange);
    color: var(--orange);
  }

  /* ─── HERO STATS ─── */
  .hero-stats {
    display: flex; gap: 2rem; margin-top: 3.5rem;
    padding-top: 2.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; }

  .stat-n {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-size: 2.2rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--orange);
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .stat-l {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  /* ─── HERO PLATFORM MOCKUP ─── */
  .hero-right {
    position: relative; z-index: 2;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }

  .platform-mockup {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 520px;
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow:
      0 40px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
      0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05),
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes  float {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-12px); }
  }

  .mockup-header {
    background: var(--navy-light);
    padding: 0.8rem 1.2rem;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .mockup-dot {
    width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%;
  }

  .mockup-dot:nth-child(1) { background: #FF5F57; }
  .mockup-dot:nth-child(2) { background: #FFBD2E; }
  .mockup-dot:nth-child(3) { background: #28C940; }

  .mockup-title {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    margin-left: 0.5rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }

  .mockup-body { padding: 1.2rem; }

  .mockup-row {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    background: var(--white-faint);
    border-left: 3px solid transparent;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    cursor: default;
  }

  .mockup-row:nth-child(1) { border-left-color: var(--orange); }
  .mockup-row:nth-child(2) { border-left-color: #3B82F6; }
  .mockup-row:nth-child(3) { border-left-color: #10B981; }
  .mockup-row:nth-child(4) { border-left-color: var(--orange-light); opacity: 0.6; }

  .mockup-row:hover { background: rgba(244,241,236,0.12); }

  .mockup-source {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.2rem;
  }

  .mockup-source-name {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--white);
  }

  .mockup-source-meta {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    color: var(--white-dim);
  }

  .mockup-tone {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }

  .tone-pos { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.15); color: #10B981; }
  .tone-neu { background: rgba(244,241,236,0.1); color: var(--white-dim); }
  .tone-neg { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.15); color: #EF4444; }

  .mockup-stats {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0.6rem; margin-top: 1rem; padding-top: 1rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .mockup-stat {
    background: var(--white-faint);
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 0.7rem;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .mockup-stat-n {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--orange);
    display: block;
  }

  .mockup-stat-l {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  }

  /* ─── SECTIONS COMMUNES ─── */
  section { padding: 6rem 4rem; }

  .section-tag {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--orange);
    margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem;
  }

  .section-tag::after {
    content: '';
    flex: 1; max-width: 40px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--orange);
  }

  .section-title {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.15;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }

  .section-title em { font-style: italic; color: var(--orange); }

  .section-sub {
    color: var(--white-dim);
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
    max-width: 600px;
  }

  /* ─── COUVERTURE ─── */
  #couverture {
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .coverage-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 1px;
    background: var(--border);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 3rem;
  }

  .coverage-item {
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem;
    transition: background 0.3s;
  }

  .coverage-item:hover { background: var(--navy-light); }

  .coverage-icon {
    width: 44px; height: 44px;
    background: var(--orange-glow);
    border: 1px solid rgba(232,107,42,0.3);
    border-radius: 4px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
  }

  .coverage-name {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .coverage-desc {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .coverage-lang {
    display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .lang-tag {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 2px;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  }

  /* ─── SERVICES ─── */
  #services { background: var(--navy); }

  .services-layout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 4rem;
    margin-top: 3rem;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .service-card {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 2rem;
    background: var(--white-faint);
    transition: all 0.4s;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .service-card::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: var(--orange);
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: left;
    transition: transform 0.4s;
  }

  .service-card:hover { border-color: rgba(232,107,42,0.3); }
  .service-card:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }

  .service-number {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: var(--orange);
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }

  .service-name {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-size: 1.6rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .service-desc {
    color: var(--white-dim);
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }

  .service-features {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .service-feature {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--white-dim);
  }

  .service-feature::before {
    content: '→';
    color: var(--orange);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .service-card.featured {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-light), var(--navy-mid));
    border-color: rgba(232,107,42,0.4);
    grid-column: span 2;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .service-card.featured::before { transform: scaleX(1); }

  .service-card.featured .service-name {
    font-size: 2rem;
  }

  .platform-preview {
    background: var(--navy);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }

  .preview-bar {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 1rem; padding-bottom: 0.8rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .preview-bar-title {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    color: var(--orange);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }

  .preview-export {
    display: flex; gap: 0.4rem;
  }

  .export-btn {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 0.58rem;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 2px;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }

  .export-btn.active {
    background: var(--orange);
    border-color: var(--orange);
    color: white;
  }

  .preview-article {
    display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 0.8rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .preview-article:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

  .preview-source-badge {
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    background: var(--navy-light);
    padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem;
    border-radius: 2px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .preview-article-title {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    color: var(--white);
    line-height: 1.4;
    flex: 1;
  }

  /* ─── PLATEFORME ─── */
  #plateforme {
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .platform-layout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 5rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-top: 3rem;
  }

  .platform-features {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.5rem;
  }

  .platform-feature {
    display: flex; gap: 1.2rem; align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 1.2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    cursor: default;
  }

  .platform-feature:hover {
    background: var(--white-faint);
    border-color: rgba(232,107,42,0.3);
  }

  .pf-icon {
    width: 36px; height: 36px; flex-shrink: 0;
    background: var(--orange-glow);
    border: 1px solid rgba(232,107,42,0.3);
    border-radius: 4px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }

  .pf-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; }

  .pf-title {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .pf-desc {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .big-mockup {
    background: var(--navy);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }

  .big-mockup-header {
    background: var(--navy-light);
    padding: 0.9rem 1.2rem;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .big-mockup-nav {
    display: flex; gap: 0;
    background: var(--navy);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .bmn-item {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
